review_candidates.title: Channel Director - Asia
review_candidates.description: Your Role Reporting to the Head of Sales, Asia. This role is pivotal in driving revenue through the recruitment, activation and engagement of new and existing MSP, SI and DCO partners. As Channel Director, you will be responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth through strategic partnerships, market expansion and executive engagement across the Asia market. The Channel Director develops and executes initiatives by identifying high-potential partners, accelerating their onboarding, and guiding them through the partner lifecycle from initial engagement to activation and long-term revenue generation. About Megaport We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. Our Team Culture We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. What You’ll Be Doing Define and execute the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Asia Channel in partnership with APAC leadership, including establishing corporate partnership frameworks, revenue sharing models, and commercial and strategic alignment across Tier-1 partners. Design and deliver tailored enablement programs that educate and empower partners on Megaport’s solutions, tools, and value proposition, driving partner capability and revenue growth. Identify and assess new channel segments, partnership models and market entry opportunities within Asia, making recommendations to APAC sales leadership on channel investment prioritisation, partner tier structures, and the long-term shape of the Megaport partner ecosystem in the region. Design the overarching Asia channel enablement framework and partner governance structures, including entry criteria, commercial terms, performance thresholds, and escalation or exit frameworks for underperforming partners. Partner with Megaport’s local Hybrid Sales Pods to shape Go-to-Market strategies that will drive the recruitment of new partners in their region and accelerate their progression through the partner lifecycle from onboarding to enablement to activation and expansion. Optimise and scale the solution sales process to improve efficiency, drive customer adoption, and support scalable growth through the channel. Formulate and drive executive-level sponsorship within target partners, lead commercial negotiations with partners to establish strategic joint go-to-market agreements, and use these to cultivate strategic alliances with sellers in named channel accounts to drive partner-sourced opportunities and pipeline growth. Oversee and manage Asia Channel performance including partner sales volume and revenue, shared program and agreement governance, and the selection and prioritisation of Megaport’s partner ecosystem to ensure long-term profitability and regional performance. Ensure, where practical, Megaport solutions are productised and remuneration plans relating to Megaport products are clearly defined for channel sellers in your accounts. Execute targeted channel campaigns in collaboration with channel partners to ensure alignment of long-term partner capabilities with Megaport’s strategic Channel roadmap, including the promotion of Megaport’s latest products, solution offerings, and use cases to educate, train, and equip partner sellers for success. Represent Asia channel interests within Megaport’s global channel leadership forums, ensuring regional strategy is aligned with and contributes to global channel priorities. Represent Megaport at key partner events, acting as an integral link to our Hybrid Sales Pods & Channel partners to strengthen presence, visibility and engagement. What We Are Looking For Based in Hong Kong, Singapore or Japan, or willing to travel frequently across the region. 8+ years of experience in senior sales leadership experience working with MSP and SI’s, with a background in telecommunications, networking, cloud, or IT services sales within the Channel. Experience in contributing to the development of a channel GTM strategy and building out and leading a team to execute that strategy. Demonstrated success in recruiting, enabling, and scaling partner ecosystems. Experience with SI’s an advantage. Deep understanding of the channel landscape in both Asia markets, with established relationships with leadership in key partner organisations. Drive cross-functional alignment with multiple business units, partners and solution teams. Demonstrated history of driving revenue expansion and consistently outperforming commercial targets and strategic KPIs. High-level commercial autonomy with a proven record of managing complex, high-value channel relationships, regional revenue and risk forecasting, and operating independently within global reporting structures. Entrepreneurial mindset; flexible and adaptable. Comfortable operating independently within a globally distributed organisational structure. Willingness and capability to travel across the Asia region for strategic partner meetings, enablement sessions, and key industry events (anticipate that up to 50% of your working time will be spent travelling). What We Offer Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with co-working options available Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com". All applications will be treated in confidence.
